//: Lighthouse CI performance gate (WP-046). Protects the ≥90 P/A/BP/SEO invariant recovered by WP-044. Run: npx lhci autorun. The workflow builds the site with a localhost baseURL, then LHCI starts the compressed static server and measures the matrix.

settings.//: Lighthouse defaults are the mobile preset (Moto-G-class emulation + slow-4G throttle) — matches WP-044's measurement.

assert.//: median-run over 3 runs is the anti-flakiness mechanism (WP-044 documented +/-10pt runner variance). API-backed pages (/leaderboard/, /roadmap/) fetch the live feedback API, which is CORS-blocked from a localhost origin in CI -> a console error that dings Best Practices only; their Perf/A11y/SEO are unaffected, so they are gated on Performance alone. Every other page gates all four categories at >=90.

upload.//: Reports go to LHCI temporary public storage (shareable URLs printed in the CI log); nothing is committed (WP-005: lighthouse JSON is local-only).
